description: HACK CITY - Beyond the City. Beyond the Code. HACK CITY by Your Developers is an exciting, GTA VI-inspired hackathon where creativity meets Artificial Intelligence. Step into a virtual world inspired by Vice City and turn your innovative ideas into reality using AI, Generative AI, LLMs, and intelligent systems. Participants will explore three exciting problem statements: The Living City , Side Quest Generator , and Wanted: Vice City , each offering unique challenges with increasing levels of difficulty. From creating intelligent virtual characters to generating dynamic missions and building AI-powered simulations, HACKCITY encourages students to think beyond boundaries, experiment with emerging technologies, collaborate, and build impactful solutions. Get ready to code, create, innovate, and conquer the city!

problem_sources.text: AI-Powered NPC Interaction System Problem Description Open-world games like GTA are known for their immersive environments, where Non-Player Characters (NPCs) make the virtual world feel alive. However, most traditional NPCs rely on predefined dialogues and repetitive behaviours, making interactions predictable. What if every character in the city could think, communicate, remember, and respond intelligently? Your challenge is to build an AI-powered NPC interaction system that transforms an ordinary virtual city into a living, interactive environment. Create intelligent characters with unique personalities, backgrounds, and the ability to engage in dynamic conversations with players. Key Features Create multiple NPCs with unique personalities and roles. Enable dynamic AI-powered conversations. Implement basic memory so NPCs can remember previous interactions. Make NPC responses context-aware. Build an interactive interface where players can select and communicate with different NPCs. AI Requirements Integrate an LLM such as Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, or an open-source model. Use role-based prompts to define NPC personalities. Implement conversation history or memory. Expected Deliverable A functional prototype featuring at least 3 intelligent NPCs with different personalities, capable of having contextual conversations with players. Important: Building a complete 3D game is not mandatory. A web-based interactive simulation is sufficient. Bonus Challenges Voice-based NPC conversations. NPC mood and emotion simulation. Long-term NPC memory. NPC reactions based on previous player interactions. Let the city come alive with AI!
problem_sources.title: AI-Powered NPC Interaction System

problem_sources.text: AI-Powered Wanted Level and Police Response Simulator Problem Description One of the most iconic features of open-world games like GTA is the wanted-level system. Whenever a player performs certain in-game actions, the police respond according to the severity of the situation. As the wanted level increases, the challenges become more intense and unpredictable. But what if the entire police response system could be made intelligent using Artificial Intelligence? Your challenge is to build an AI-powered wanted-level simulation system where player actions influence the wanted level, trigger dynamic events, and generate intelligent police responses in a fictional open-world city. Create an interactive simulation where the system understands player actions and dynamically adapts its response based on the situation. Key Features Player Action Simulation: Allow players to perform simulated in-game actions through an interactive dashboard. Wanted Level System: Implement a 1–5 star wanted-level mechanism based on player actions. AI Incident Classification: Use AI to analyze simulated player actions and recommend an appropriate severity level. Dynamic Police Response: Generate different fictional police responses based on the current wanted level. AI Event Generation: Generate random in-game events, challenges, and consequences. Live Dashboard: Display current wanted level, player status, active incidents, police responses, and mission updates. Dynamic Difficulty: Increase the intensity of the simulation as the wanted level increases. AI Requirements Integrate an LLM such as Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, or an open-source model. Use AI to interpret simulated player actions and classify incidents. Generate contextual police response scenarios using AI. Maintain game state and conversation/context history between interactions. Implement AI-based decision-making for dynamic event generation. Expected Deliverable A functional interactive web application that simulates a GTA-inspired wanted-level system, where player actions trigger AI-powered incident classification, changing wanted levels, dynamic police responses, and in-game consequences. Important: Developing a complete 3D game or actual police simulation is not mandatory. A browser-based interactive simulation with a working AI decision-making system is sufficient. Bonus Challenges AI-generated police radio conversations. Voice-controlled player actions. Interactive city map showing incident locations. Multiple police response strategies. AI-generated random missions and challenges. Dynamic events based on player history. The city is watching. Every action has a consequence!
problem_sources.title: AI-Powered Wanted Level and Police Response Simulator

problem_sources.text: AI-Powered Dynamic Mission Generator Problem Description One of the most exciting aspects of open-world games like GTA is the ability to explore the city, discover new missions, complete challenges, and earn rewards. However, traditional games generally offer a fixed set of predefined missions. What if every player could experience unique missions generated dynamically using Artificial Intelligence? Your challenge is to build an AI-powered mission generator that creates unique, interactive, and engaging game missions based on player preferences, selected difficulty levels, and mission categories. Players should be able to generate new missions, explore their objectives, accept challenges, and track their progress through an interactive platform. Key Features AI Mission Generation: Generate unique missions with the help of an LLM. Difficulty Selection: Allow players to choose Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty. Mission Categories: Include racing, delivery, exploration, rescue, treasure hunting, and other fictional challenges. Mission Details: Generate a mission title, storyline, objectives, time limit, difficulty, and virtual rewards. Accept or Reject Missions: Allow players to accept a generated mission or request another one. Progress Tracking: Track completed objectives and mission status. Mission History: Maintain records of previously generated and completed missions. AI Requirements Integrate an LLM such as Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, or an open-source model. Use structured AI responses (JSON) to generate consistent mission information. Generate missions based on user-selected categories and difficulty levels. Ensure missions have meaningful objectives and achievable challenges. Expected Deliverable A functional web application where users can generate, explore, accept, and complete AI-generated fictional missions through an interactive dashboard. Important: Developing a complete 3D game is not mandatory. A web-based mission generation and tracking platform is sufficient. Bonus Challenges AI-generated mission maps. Personalized missions based on player history. XP, coins, and reward systems. Leaderboards for completed missions. Dynamic mission storylines based on player choices. Don't just play the game. Create the next mission!
problem_sources.title: AI-Powered Dynamic Mission Generator

problem_sources.text: GTA is full of possibilities, challenges, and opportunities waiting to be explored. Your mission is to think beyond predefined boundaries and build something innovative that can transform the virtual world or solve real-world problems. Participants are free to identify a problem, explore an opportunity, and develop an innovative solution using technology. Your project can be related to Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, Web Development, App Development, Automation, Blockchain, Gaming, or any emerging technology. Challenge Build an original and impactful solution that demonstrates creativity, technical innovation, and practical implementation. You have complete freedom to choose your problem statement, technology stack, and approach.
